classification.difficultyReason: Identify and name every interior angle in a triangle and a quadrilateral.

content.prompt: Name all the angles of each figure below.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle FGH; ordinary source blue rendered black.
spec.mathematics: G bottom left, H bottom right, F above and slightly right of G; GH horizontal.

answer.worked: Name one angle at each vertex, keeping the vertex in the middle: at $G$, $\angle FGH$; at $H$, $\angle GHF$; at $F$, $\angle HFG$. Reversing either angle's arm letters gives the same angle.

spec.description: Unshaded parallelogram RSTU without added marks; ordinary source blue rendered black.
spec.mathematics: R upper left, S upper right, T lower right and U lower left; RS and UT horizontal.

answer.worked: Name one angle at each vertex, keeping the vertex in the middle: at $S$, $\angle RST$; at $T$, $\angle STU$; at $U$, $\angle TUR$; at $R$, $\angle URS$. Reversed names are also valid.
